prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photoreal 4:5 candid night flash portrait of an adult woman with shoulder-length curly red hair, soft bangs, light freckles, winged eyeliner, and a small septum ring. She sits upright in the rear seat of an unbranded luxury car with light-gray diamond-stitched leather, wearing a black long-sleeve mock-neck blouse, charcoal tailored trousers, black ankle boots, and simple unbranded gold earrings. Her ankles are neatly crossed, one hand rests on her lap, and the other is relaxed near the window. Show blurred city traffic outside, direct camera flash, detailed leather texture, natural skin, and a composed urban-night aesthetic. No badge, logos, screen text, or suggestive pose.
